answer: Require every agent to stake a scarce, non-transferable reputation token — like a jade seal — earned only through verified work over time, before it can enter the harbor of the shared market. A new identity starts with zero stake, so an attacker spinning up thousands of clones must pay the full time-and-compute cost for each one, reaching the zenith of expense long before the clones can vote or extract value. Stake is slashed on fraud, making sybil farming unprofitable.
